acceptance_criteria.name: B1_engagement_beyond_newest_four_with_stationary_selectivity_PRIMARY
acceptance_criteria.rule: PRIMARY criterion for this experiment - the graded preceding-pair candidate's B1 engagement is this cycle's selected limitation (PRIMARY criterion 10 FAILed on both of its cohorts on the B1 side: TAKEN 1/6 on both, retained partials 0/6 on both, newest-four opposition total >= 2 at only 1/6 pooled B1 states per cohort, silent at 3/6 development and 1/6 additional), while its stationary side PASSed on development at exact recent8 parity and FAILed on additional by 1 success on a single carried FULL firing. This criterion is the conjunction of the two carried forms, graded per cohort, and PASSes only if BOTH sides hold on the same cohort: (a) STATIONARY SIDE, criterion 6's frozen form on the stationary control arm pooled across checkpoints 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32 (240 episode-checkpoints): candidate failed-by-abstention <= 32 of 240, AND candidate successes >= recent8 successes - 6, AND candidate harmful TEST actions <= recent8 harmful TEST actions; AND (b) B1 SIDE, criterion 9's frozen form as updated for this cycle over the B1 pooled onset cells (checkpoints 2 and 4 x 3 seeds; 96 episode-checkpoints; engagement graded from the candidate's recorded decision records ONLY, no TEST outcomes): abstention TAKEN (a trigger class holds - full, retained partial, or widened - carried-over abstention authority armed, abstention gate armed for the trigger kind - leg P, plus leg R when the trigger is partial - acting source abstained) in at least 3 of the 6 pooled B1 onset seed-checkpoint states, AND at least 1 of the taken states is a NON-FULL firing (a RETAINED partial-only firing, abstention_trigger_kind == 'partial', or a WIDENED firing, abstention_trigger_kind == 'widened' - a state the graded preceding-pair candidate's rule could not have taken, so neither the carried full trigger alone nor a widened class that never fires can be credited with the non-full engagement); AND (c) B1 HARM vs GUARD - candidate harmful TEST actions pooled over the B1 onset cells <= evidence_opposition_guard harmful TEST actions pooled over the same cells on the same cohort; AND (d) B1 HARM vs RECENT8 - candidate harmful TEST actions pooled over the B1 onset cells < recent8 harmful TEST actions pooled over the same cells on the same cohort (strictly below: equality FAILs, as in the preceding protocols). Every figure is ALSO reported split by checkpoint (2 alone vs 4 alone vs pooled) and, for abstentions, by trigger kind (full / partial / widened) and by newest-four total and acting-window count, because the widened class's population differs by checkpoint by construction (effectively checkpoint-2 only): a pooled PASS whose widened firings are concentrated at checkpoint 2, or whose stationary survivals are widened firings, must be visible in the report, not averaged away. The widened firing count at B1 is reported EXPLICITLY on each cohort (including when it is zero): the grading cap in the grading record (a Demonstrated verdict requires at least one widened B1 firing in at least one cohort) applies on top of this criterion, so a conjunction PASS with zero widened firings on both cohorts is reported as a carried-classes pass with a widened null result, never as a widened-window demonstration. Taken and disarmed states are reported against the records-only preceding-pair-rule (full + leg P, partial + leg P + leg R: the graded preceding-pair candidate's exact rule, the decisive derivation), widened-rule (this candidate's own rule, for cross-checking), partial-purity-rule (trigger >= 1 + leg P, no leg R), purity-only-rule (trigger == 2 + leg P), partial-ungated-rule (trigger >= 1, no gate), reference-purity-rule (trigger == 2, no gate), abstention-release-rule (leg P + acting_opposed_count >= 3, full-pair trigger), and abstention-higher-corroboration-rule (leg P + acting_opposed_count >= 4, full-pair trigger) derivations at the same states (see metrics_reported), so the report states exactly how many stationary firings the widened class added on THIS cohort, how many B1 firings it added, split by checkpoint, and what each side was worth in successes and harm. B1 and control successes are reported in full alongside (not graded beyond sides (a) and (b)-(d) as stated, to keep the harm claim honest rather than productivity-free: always_abstain would pass (c) and (d) trivially and fail (a), so the report must state candidate B1 pooled successes against recent8's and the guard's explicitly). Criteria 9 and 6 are ALSO graded individually below in their carried forms, so a failure of this conjunction is attributable to its exact side and sub-condition, never hidden inside the PRIMARY verdict.

acceptance_criteria.name: first_switch_B1_engagement_beyond_newest_four_preserved
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, criterion 9's B1 form carried from the preceding-pair protocol and updated only in its non-full credit (retained partial OR widened) - the B1 side of PRIMARY criterion 11, graded individually so the conjunction's attribution is exact. The graded preceding-pair candidate's B1 profile (TAKEN 1/6 on both cohorts, sole full firing each, B1 harm 78 = guard 78 and < recent8 92 / 94, B1 successes 2 vs recent8 4 / 2) is what this cycle must repair without giving back the harm profile. Graded per cohort over the B1 pooled onset cells (checkpoints 2 and 4 x 3 seeds; 96 episode-checkpoints; engagement graded from the candidate's recorded decision records ONLY, no TEST outcomes): (a) ENGAGEMENT - the abstention branch is TAKEN (a trigger class holds, carried-over abstention authority armed, abstention gate armed for the trigger kind (leg P; plus leg R - preceding_pair_opposed_count >= 1 - when the trigger is partial; leg P alone when the trigger is widened), acting source abstained) in at least 3 of the 6 pooled B1 onset seed-checkpoint states, AND at least 1 of the taken states is a NON-FULL firing (abstention_trigger_kind == 'partial' - a retained partial-only firing - OR abstention_trigger_kind == 'widened' - newest4_opposed_count <= 1 with acting_opposed_count >= 3, a state the graded preceding-pair candidate's rule could not have taken); AND (b) HARM vs GUARD - candidate harmful TEST actions pooled over the B1 onset cells <= evidence_opposition_guard harmful TEST actions pooled over the same cells on the same cohort; AND (c) HARM vs RECENT8 - candidate harmful TEST actions pooled over the B1 onset cells < recent8 harmful TEST actions pooled over the same cells on the same cohort (strictly below: equality FAILs, as in the preceding protocols). Taken states are reported split by checkpoint (2 alone vs 4 alone vs pooled) AND by trigger kind (full / partial / widened), with the realized reference_purity, purity_armed flag, opposed_count, preceding_pair_opposed_count, newest4_opposed_count, and acting_opposed_count at each, and against the records-only preceding-pair-rule (the decisive derivation), widened-rule (this candidate's own rule, for cross-checking), partial-purity-rule, purity-only-rule, partial-ungated-rule, reference-purity-rule, abstention-release-rule, and abstention-higher-corroboration-rule derivations at the same states (see metrics_reported), so the report states exactly how many B1 firings the widened class added on THIS cohort, split by checkpoint, how many leg P, leg R, or authority blocked, and what each added or removed firing was worth in harm. B1 successes are reported in full alongside (not graded here, to keep the harm claim honest rather than productivity-free: always_abstain would pass (b) and (c) trivially, so the report must state candidate B1 pooled successes against recent8's and the guard's explicitly). Recovery and minority firing at B1 are reported alongside, as in the preceding protocols.

acceptance_criteria.name: stationary_control_selectivity_not_given_back
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the preceding protocols - the stationary side of PRIMARY criterion 11, graded individually so the conjunction's attribution is exact. In the preceding generation this criterion PASSed on development at exact recent8 parity (0/240 abstentions, 110 = 110 successes, 130 = 130 harm - a leg-retention pass: the partial-purity-rule took 2 control states and leg R disarmed both) and FAILed on additional by 1 success on ONE carried FULL firing (seed 443017 k=2, purity 0.889), leg R having disarmed all three partial stationary states there. This cycle prices TWO retained exposures: the carried classes' stationary volume exactly as before (full firings untouched by any leg; retained partials at the preceding-pair rate), AND the NEW widened exposure - a stationary state whose newest four are silent or split (about 0.87 raw / 0.92 adjusted of control states) but whose acting window accumulates >= 3 opposed events (joint 0.056 raw / 0.034 adjusted per state, an expected 0.8 raw / 0.5 adjusted widened control firings per cohort) fires behind leg P alone. Graded per cohort, on the stationary control arm pooled across checkpoints 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32 (240 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate failed-by-abstention <= 32 of 240, AND (b) candidate successes >= recent8 successes - 6, AND (c) candidate harmful TEST actions <= recent8 harmful TEST actions. The realized reference_purity, opposed_count, preceding_pair_opposed_count, newest4_opposed_count, acting_opposed_count, and abstention_trigger_kind on the control arm are recorded and reported at every checkpoint, alongside the realized minority_fraction and minority_armed values exactly as in the preceding protocols; every control checkpoint at which the candidate's taken branch differs from the records-only preceding-pair-rule derivation (in particular every WIDENED state, which the graded preceding-pair candidate would not have taken) and from the records-only partial-purity-rule and purity-only-rule derivations, and every abstention that was taken, is stated explicitly in the report, with the taken or disarmed state's purity, opposed counts, and trigger kind named. If no stationary widened trigger survived on a cohort, the PASS is reported with the widened-armed and widened-disarmed counts stated - not as a no-trigger PASS, since the widened-rule derivation states how many widened triggers existed.

acceptance_criteria.name: release_and_productivity_by_checkpoint_32
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard - the graded partial candidate PASSed it on the additional cohort and FAILed it on development on the records sub-condition (c) alone (2 of 9 non-recent8 states, both carried minority routings, abstained branch 0 of 9 on both cohorts, the development zero via an exercised leg-P release at purity 0.658 and the additional zero via two leg-P-disarmed return-A partial triggers); all four sub-conditions are carried unchanged in form, and neither the preceding-pair leg nor the widened class must give any of them back - sub-condition (d) is the exposed one: for partial triggers, at checkpoint 32 the preceding pair shares the newest pair's segment, so a late partial trigger's leg-R retention is segment-dependent; for WIDENED triggers, at checkpoint 32 the whole acting window lies inside one segment, so a late widened trigger is an accumulation of same-segment noise at that segment's opposed rate, composed with leg P's realized checkpoint-32 arming (roughly 0.44-0.67 per late state in the preceding cohorts) - a release path neither the partial nor the preceding-pair generation exercised, since neither had a widened class. Graded per cohort, pooled across stages B1, return_A, and B2 at checkpoint 32 (144 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate failed-by-abstention <= 36 of 144 (25 percent), AND (b) candidate successes >= recent8 successes - 8 (carried over unchanged from the preceding protocols), AND (c) from the candidate's decision records alone, among the 9 switch-stage checkpoint-32 seed-checkpoint states (3 stages x 3 seeds), the candidate takes a non-recent8 branch (retained_archive, minority_archive, or abstained) in at most 1 state - the carried records-level release measure for the recovery branches - AND (d) the candidate takes the ABSTAINED branch in 0 of those 9 states (carried from the preceding protocols: both combined-gate generations and the partial generation removed abstention from the late records on both cohorts; the preceding-pair leg must hold that at zero for partial triggers, not merely at the carried allowance). The realized reference_purity, purity_armed, opposing counts (newest opposed_count, preceding_pair_opposed_count, newest4_opposed_count, acting_opposed_count, and supporting_opposed_count) and abstention_trigger_kind at all 9 states are reported alongside, split by branch taken, so the report distinguishes a leg-P release of a late abstention (trigger present, purity disarmed, fell through to recent8), a leg-R release of a late PARTIAL abstention (trigger partial, purity armed, preceding_pair_opposed_count == 0, fell through to recent8), a late WIDENED trigger released by leg P (kind widened, purity disarmed) or never armed (widened_armed false), and a state where no abstention trigger of any class was present at all, and likewise distinguishes the recovery branches' purity releases as in the preceding protocols.

acceptance_criteria.name: second_switch_B2_protection_preserved
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, carried over unchanged in form from the minority, reference-purity, abstention-release, and abstention-higher-corroboration protocols: neither the preceding-pair leg on partial abstention (carried) nor the widened trigger class (new) must give back the B2 protection the minority branch demonstrated (abstention is not the B2 protective branch - minority recovery is, and it sits above abstention in the decision order - but changed abstention firing at B2 states where neither recovery branch fired - retained partials at checkpoint 4, leg-R-disarmed partials at checkpoint 2, and widened firings at either checkpoint where the newest four are silent or split and the acting window accumulates >= 3 - changes those states' harm, in either direction, and that is charged here). Graded per cohort over the B2 pooled onset cells (checkpoints 2 and 4 x 3 seeds; 96 episode-checkpoints; engagement graded from the candidate's recorded decision records ONLY, no TEST outcomes): (a) ENGAGEMENT - the minority recovery branch is TAKEN (minority_joint_count >= 1, minority branch armed, purity gate armed, acting source minority_archive) in at least 3 of the 6 pooled B2 onset seed-checkpoint states; AND (b) SELECTIVITY - the minority recovery branch is taken in at most 1 of the 6 pooled B1 onset states AND at most 1 of the 6 pooled return-A onset states on the same cohort; AND (c) HARM - candidate harmful TEST actions pooled over the B2 onset cells <= evidence_opposition_guard harmful TEST actions pooled over the same cells on the same cohort, AND candidate B2 pooled onset harm <= 0.60 * recent8 B2 pooled onset harm on the same cohort; AND (d) PRODUCTIVITY - candidate successes pooled over the B2 onset cells >= evidence_opposition_guard successes pooled over the same cells + 16. Taken states are reported split by checkpoint (2 alone vs 4 alone vs pooled), with the realized minority_fraction, minority_armed flag, reference_purity, and purity_armed flag at each, and against the records-only minority-rule and reference-purity-rule derivations (see metrics_reported). Abstention-branch firing (split by trigger kind, now including widened) and abstention-gate disarmings (by cause: leg P vs leg R vs both) at B2 are reported (with realized opposed_count, preceding_pair_opposed_count, newest4_opposed_count, and acting_opposed_count at each) but do NOT count toward sub-condition (a), as in the preceding protocols.

acceptance_criteria.name: return_A_onset_harm_preserved
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, carried over unchanged from the preceding protocols: per cohort, pooled across return_A checkpoints 2 and 4 (96 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate harmful TEST actions <= evidence_opposition_guard harmful TEST actions over the same cells, AND (b) candidate harmful TEST actions <= 0.60 * recent8 harmful TEST actions over the same cells. The graded partial candidate PASSed it on development (36 vs guard 75, ceiling 52.2) and FAILed it on additional (53 vs guard 53 - sub-condition (a) PASS at equality - but ceiling 51.0 FAIL by 2; candidate identical to every carried gate-generation baseline method at return-A onset on additional, regular recovery TAKEN 4 of 6 there and 6 of 6 on development: inherited from the carried profile, not produced by the widened trigger, charged unchanged in that grading); it is carried unchanged as a co-graded guard: at return-A onset the abstention branch is mostly disarmed by stable disagreement already, so the preceding-pair leg's and the widened class's exposure here is small by construction (a widened firing at return-A onset is nevertheless possible wherever the authority is armed and the newest four are silent or split), and any change - or any repeat of the inherited failure - is charged as recorded, with widened firings at return-A reported by kind.

acceptance_criteria.name: return_A_recovery_successes_preserved
acceptance_criteria.rule: Per cohort, pooled across return_A checkpoints 2 and 4 (96 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate successes >= 40 percent of frozen_A successes pooled over the same cells (computed as candidate_successes * 5 >= frozen_A_successes * 2, carried over unchanged from the preceding protocols), AND (b) candidate successes >= evidence_opposition_guard successes pooled over the same cells + 16 (carried over unchanged). Cumulative's, the joint candidate's, the bounded candidate's, the long candidate's, the extended candidate's, the minority candidate's, the reference-purity candidate's, the abstention-release candidate's, the abstention-higher-corroboration candidate's, and the partial-opposition and preceding-pair candidates' return-A successes on the same cohort are reported alongside in full, and any shortfall is stated in the report, not hidden. The abstention branch (at any trigger threshold or gate composition) sits below both recovery branches and does not enter this criterion's mechanism; the abstention-purity-only, partial-opposition, and preceding-pair candidates' return-A successes on the same cohort are also reported alongside in full; it is carried so that any unexpected interaction (for example a fall-through change at a return-A onset state) is graded, not assumed away.

acceptance_criteria.name: pooled_onset_harm_not_above_guard
acceptance_criteria.rule: Per cohort, pooled across the six onset cells (stages B1, return_A, B2 x checkpoints 2 and 4; 288 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate harmful TEST actions <= evidence_opposition_guard harmful TEST actions pooled over the same six cells on the same cohort, AND (b) candidate harmful TEST actions <= recent8 harmful TEST actions in at least 5 of the 6 individual cells. Carried over unchanged from the graded joint, bounded, long, extended, minority, reference-purity, abstention-release, abstention-higher-corroboration, abstention-purity-only, and partial-opposition protocols. The graded partial candidate PASSed it on both cohorts (75 vs guard 198, 6 of 6 cells, development; 102 vs guard 171, 6 of 6, additional - the pooled figure the higher-corroboration generation failed on additional, restored by the B1 repair); this cycle grades whether the carried legs plus the widened class keep the pooled figure under the guard on NEW cohorts - in particular whether widened firings at B1, B2, or return-A (which remove harm where recent8 was harmful and add none where they fire, but displace nothing) or the carried checkpoint-2 partial disarmings return any cell's harm past recent8 or the pooled figure past the guard. Checkpoint 0 is reported but NOT graded.

Any missing field fails this criterion regardless of scores.

boundaries: No privileged simulator information to the learner; the oracle is a labeled reference only.
No learner-issued training interventions; all TRAIN evidence comes from the shared external actor stream.
No default controller promotion, no PR merge, no D1-D10 or V2A/V2B roadmap change, no AthenZ/Synveil integration (hard gates requiring the owner's explicit authorization).
Same engineered two-feature simulator family as the preceding switch experiments; results are not evidence of independent generalization, novel rule discovery, or real-world safety.
Preserve all negative results with the same prominence as positive ones.

fixed_parameters.threshold_justification: Fixed a priori from the simulator's known noise rates, the preceding experiments' published graded aggregates and decision records, and this simulator's published segment geometry, not from any score of this experiment (none exist). (i) WIDENED WINDOW = the acting window, last 8 events (carried records, new role): at onset checkpoint k only the newest k events of any window are post-switch, so widening adds only p-rate events and the onset excess is fixed at k * (q - p); the threshold scan over windows 4..50 on the published rate pairs (full derivation kept with the campaign state) shows windows wider than 8 are dominated (their stationary tails at any pooled-onset-comparable threshold are no better, and their widened-only joint probabilities no larger), and the acting window is the widest window already present in every graded decision record since the release generations, which keeps the widened count records-checkable against all of them. (ii) WIDENED THRESHOLD acting_opposed_count >= 3 with newest4_opposed_count <= 1 (THE SINGLE CHANGED ELEMENT): the population bound <= 1 is the selection's own definition of the unreached population (newest pair + predecessor jointly silent (0) or split (1)); the count threshold >= 3 is the unique non-vacuous point on this window - at >= 2 the stationary widened-only rate is 0.256 raw / 0.195 adjusted per state (about 3.8 / 2.9 extra control firings per cohort of 15, breaching criterion 6(a)'s 32/240 budget by itself, before any carried class fires), and at >= 4 the widened-only onset joint probability collapses to about 0.003 raw / 0.000 adjusted (expected firings per cohort about 0.01 - a class that cannot fire is not an experiment). >= 3 gives joint onset 0.025 raw / 0.031 adjusted at checkpoint 2 and stationary 0.056 / 0.034 per state - the least-bad point, frozen with its stationary risk pre-registered, NOT chosen from the realized acting-8 counts on any inspected cohort (those counts are thin and overlap the additional control arm; see limitation_evidence). (iii) PRIMARY FLOORS AND MARGINS CARRIED, NOT RE-TUNED: criterion 11 conjoins criterion 9's B1 form (>= 3 of 6 taken, >= 1 non-full firing - here a retained partial or a widened firing, since a full-only pass would credit neither the partial widening nor this cycle's widened class; harm <= guard and < recent8) with criterion 6's stationary form (<= 32/240 abstentions, successes >= recent8 - 6, harm <= recent8), both carried at their frozen values from the preceding-pair protocol, which carried them from its predecessors. (iv) ALL other thresholds carried unchanged: leg P at reference_purity >= 0.70, full trigger at opposed_count == 2, partial trigger at opposed_count == 1, leg R at preceding_pair_opposed_count >= 1, minority arming at fraction >= 0.25 AND discordant >= 8, joint tests at count >= 1, authority strict-majority D * 2 > C in both windows, corroboration at recent_concordant_count >= 2 - none re-tuned against any inspected cohort.
fixed_parameters.widened_window_trigger: THE SINGLE NEW ELEMENT, computed from the observed reported stream only. The ACTING WINDOW is the last 8 observed events, scored EXACTLY as the acting-window records are scored in the graded candidates: each event against the SAME extended 50-event reference window's per-span majorities (strictly-highest reported class wins, tie or empty gives null; matched iff expectation and reported class are both progress or damage; opposed iff matched and different). acting_matched_count and acting_opposed_count are in 0..8 and are ALREADY recorded in full in every graded candidate since the abstention-release generation (there as records-only / leg-S inputs). newest4_opposed_count = opposed_count + preceding_pair_opposed_count, in 0..4, the opposition total over the newest four events, both of whose components are already decision records in the graded preceding-pair candidate. The WIDENED class is ARMED (as a trigger, before the carried authority and leg P) iff newest4_opposed_count <= 1 AND acting_opposed_count >= 3 (WIDENED_THRESHOLD = 3). It is consulted ONLY where neither carried class takes the state: full triggers (opposed_count == 2) and retained partials (opposed_count == 1 AND preceding_pair_opposed_count >= 1, which forces newest4_opposed_count >= 2) are decided exactly as in the graded preceding-pair candidate, whatever the acting window says; the widened class's population is by construction disjoint from both. Window positions are stream-relative only (the last eight observed events); no segment, phase, stage, checkpoint, or elapsed-since-switch information enters the class - its checkpoint asymmetry (a real population at checkpoint 2, near-empty at checkpoint 4) is a consequence of the published segment geometry acting on a fixed stream-relative window, not of any privileged boundary, exactly as the design purity values are consequences for the purity leg in the preceding protocols. Note, stated for the record: the acting window lies inside the extended reference window's span of indices, as the acting-window records already did in the graded candidates; its events are scored against reference majorities computed over a window that includes them, identically to the computations carried over unchanged.

Checkpoint-4 widened emptiness (pre-registered, by construction): at checkpoint 4 the newest four are all post-switch, so newest4_opposed_count <= 1 is rare (about 0.015 raw / 0.108 adjusted) and the widened class is effectively a checkpoint-2-only population. Late widened firing at checkpoint 32 (pre-registered): at k=32 the acting window lies inside one segment on every stage, so a widened trigger there is an accumulation of same-segment noise at the segment's own opposed rate composed with leg P's realized checkpoint-32 arming (roughly 0.44-0.67 per late state in the preceding cohorts) - the carried classes held the abstained branch at 0/9 on both preceding-pair cohorts via leg-P releases, but the widened class reads a window those releases did not gate. Widened engagement without harm conversion (pre-registered): a widened firing at a state where recent8's harm was already low removes few harmful actions while forfeiting that state's successes in full. Criteria 9 / 11 grade harm (<= guard AND < recent8) jointly with engagement, and B1 successes are reported in full against recent8's, the guard's, and always_abstain's, so an engagement PASS bought by empty abstentions cannot be reported as protection.

Displacement and disarming outside B1 (bounded, recorded): the widened class sits on the abstention branch only, below both recovery branches, so it cannot displace a recovery firing; but at B2 / return-A onset states where neither recovery branch fired, widened abstentions (possible at both onset checkpoints there - at B2 and return-A the segment geometry differs from B1's and the class is not restricted to B1) change those states' harm in either direction - charged through criteria 1, 4, and 3 unchanged, with widened firings at those stages reported by kind. Symmetrically, leg P or the carried authority can each disarm a widened B1 firing; every such disarming is recorded and charged against criteria 9 / 11 through lost protection.

Minority-model flip-symmetry limit (carried over, stated): the minority branch this candidate carries exploits this simulator's exact-inversion structure. The widened class itself is structure-agnostic in form (it reads only opposition against reference majorities in a fixed stream-relative window), but its population arithmetic depends on this simulator's symmetric flip rates (q approximately 1 - p) and on the published segment geometry; any PASS remains bounded to this inversion simulator: protective abstention for a first switch whose newest four events are silent or split, in this simulator only, not a general first-contact solution, not calibrated uncertainty, and not real-world safety.

simulator.hidden_rules: Hidden physics schedule per seed: A (original progress/damage mapping) -> B1 (progress/damage inverted) -> return_A (original) -> B2 (inverted). Phase boundaries, phase names, and the active rule are benchmark-private and are never supplied to any learner.
simulator.reported_feedback: An independent sha256 draw on (seed, TRAIN episode index) flips a non-neutral TRAIN reported progress/damage label with probability 1/20, exactly as in public_train. simulator.stationary_control_arm: A separate arm per seed with NO rule change: 240 A TRAIN episodes (indices 1000..1239) followed by 64 further A TRAIN episodes (indices 5000..5063, physics original). It measures gate and trigger selectivity when nothing changed - false recovery, false minority engagement, false abstention (including WIDENED-trigger false abstention on silent/split stationary states, this cycle's priced risk, and partial-trigger false abstention retained by the preceding-pair leg, carried) - lost productivity - and is a co-graded guard population for this experiment (criteria 11 and 6): a stationary state whose newest four are silent or split (newest4_opposed_count <= 1, probability about 0.87 raw / 0.92 adjusted per state on this arm's rates) but whose acting window carries >= 3 opposed events (joint probability 0.056 raw / 0.034 adjusted per state) AND which also passes leg P (designed armed on stationary evidence; reference window never mixes segments on this arm, design purity the pure-segment level 0.8375 at every control checkpoint) abstains, exactly the widened false-firing cost the frozen criterion 6 form prices in advance; stationary full and retained-partial firings behave exactly as in the preceding generation.
simulator.true_stochastic_feedback: Every actual non-neutral simulator action has probability 1/8 of a progress/damage flip, drawn by deterministic sha256 of (seed, split, episode index, action id, tick) exactly as in StochasticWorld._sample_outcome. Neutral outcomes stay neutral. TEST outcomes are the realized stochastic outcomes, not clean deterministic ones.
